@@ -0,0 +1,59 @@
+#!/bin/sh
+
+set -e
+
+usage() {
+	echo "Usage: dokudiff <OLD> <NEW>"
+	echo "	compare OLD with NEW line by line. Generates a simple output."
+	echo "  This is ideal for documentation purpose. Syntax highlighting"
+	echo "  for unified diff should also work."
+	echo "  ref: https://docs.gitea.io/en-us/install-with-docker/#ports"
+	echo ""
+	echo "Options:"
+	echo "  -h, --help                 Display this help message"
+	exit 1
+}
+
+parse_args() {
+	local USAGE=0
+
+	while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
+		case "$1" in
+		--help | -h)
+			USAGE=1
+			;;
+
+		*)
+			if [ -z "$OLD" ]; then
+				OLD=$1
+			elif [ -z "$NEW" ]; then
+				NEW=$1
+			else
+				echo "to many arguments: $1"
+				USAGE=1
+			fi
+			;;
+
+		esac
+		shift
+	done
+
+	if [ $USAGE -eq 1 ]; then
+		usage
+		exit
+	fi
+
+	if [ -z "$OLD" ] || [ -z "$NEW" ]; then
+		echo "Missing arguments!"
+		usage
+		exit
+	fi
+}
+
+main() {
+	parse_args "$@"
+
+	diff --new-line-format="+%L" --old-line-format="-%L" $OLD $NEW | sed --regexp-extended 's/^([+-]) /\1/'
+}
+
+main "$@"
